blurb: A Worker's bindings share one `env`, so each name can be declared once. Bynk names the bindings after what the context declares: an agent, a consumed context, a derived capability, and the `Kv` namespace of `bynk.cloudflare`, whose binding is `KV`. Here the consumed context `kv` also becomes a Service Binding named `KV`, and the two would overwrite each other. Rename the declaration behind one of them. The error is on the one you can rename, not on the `bynk.cloudflare` clause. A bundle build has no bindings, so only the Workers target checks this.
summary: A Worker would declare two bindings with the same name, such as an agent `Kv` and the `bynk.cloudflare` KV namespace (both `KV`).
